description: Get which of a company's suppliers and customers also supply or buy from its competitors, as 10-K filings name them: each one with the listed competitors it also serves, or, with vs, the company against one competitor (both, only the company, only the competitor). A competitor whose own 10-K is not read yet is marked, since other filings alone can miss what it uses. Requires the Pro plan.

maxResults.description: Maximum companies listed per side and group (default: 50, max: 500).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., NVDA), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:SU) for a listing outside the US.

vs.description: One competitor to compare with, by the symbol GetSupplyChain lists for it (e.g., AMD); omit to check every listed competitor.

name: GetSupplyChainOverlap
title: Supply Chain Overlap
